undead.description: Explicit authored undead identity. Only literal true qualifies for undead effects; absent legacy definitions remain unclassified. Never infer from names or IDs.

statusImmunities.description: Authored complete status immunities, independent of elemental resistance. Supports Freeze, Poison, Plague or complete rejection except Stun; absent or empty preserves ordinary status acceptance.

damageImmunities.description: Explicit damage-type immunity, separate from numeric resistance and status acceptance. Matching direct and periodic damage is zero; resistance penetration does not remove immunity. Absent or empty preserves ordinary mitigation.

championDamageImmunities.description: Additional explicit damage immunities only when the resolved monster tier is champion. Composed with all-tier damageImmunities; ordinary trash, elite, rare and boss variants do not inherit them.

stunDurationMultiplier.description: Authored boss/chapter-boss Stun duration coefficient replacing the generic boss reduction once. Other statuses and non-boss tiers are unaffected.

critDamage.description: Finite critical damage multiplier (1.25 means 125%); overrides the tier default without changing critical chance. Absent retains 1.5 for ordinary tiers or 1.75 for bosses.

frostAura.description: Passive cold damage and Chill to living player units, independent of monster actions. First pulse after one interval; wave-local cadence.

attack.description: Ordinary attack at level 1 [min, max]; paired with attackGrowth

attackGrowth.description: Ordinary attack growth per level [min, max]; paired with attack

skills.description: Skill IDs this monster can use

skillCooldownOverrides.description: Monster-specific cooldown seconds keyed by canonical monster.* skill ID. Missing keys retain the shared skill cooldown; transient metadata, not remaining timers.

basicAttack.description: Optional ordinary base attack; no mana or skill cooldown.

enrage.description: Sticky low-life attack-speed and optional direct-damage bonuses; base stats remain unchanged.

damagePct.description: Additive direct-damage increase in percent (50 means +50%); excludes thorns and settled periodic damage.

magicResistGrowth.description: Independent flat magical mitigation growth per level

canBeElite.description: Can this monster spawn as elite/champion?

canBeBoss.description: Can this monster be a boss?

eliteAffixes.description: Elite affix IDs this monster can roll

attackRange.description: Finite nonnegative [min, max]; endpoint order is checked by the shared runtime validator
